facts.statement: Rate is 12.5% of the overnight charge, per night

facts.statement: Base is the amount subject to VAT as lodging (i.e. excl. VAT), excluding the tourist tax itself, including bundled services
facts.value: net room price excl. VAT and excl. tourist tax
facts.quote: Als vergoeding wordt aangemerkt het bedrag dat als verschuldigd wegens logies aan de heffing van omzetbelasting is onderworpen

facts.statement: Rate unchanged for 2026
facts.publisher: KHN (hospitality association) citing municipal budget; SECONDARY
facts.quote: De toeristenbelasting blijft in 2026 op 12,5 procent van de overnachtingsprijs

facts.statement: No maximum number of nights and no child/age exemption in the ordinance; exemptions are care institutions, government-contracted refugee/homeless shelter
facts.quote: De belasting wordt niet geheven ter zake van het verblijf door degene die als verzorgde in een van overheidswege erkende inrichting

facts.statement: Liable party is the accommodation provider, who may pass it to the guest
facts.quote: Belastingplichtig is degene die gelegenheid biedt tot verblijf

facts.statement: Dutch VAT on hotel/holiday-home lodging rose from 9% to 21% (camping pitches stay 9%)
facts.quote: Voor overnachtingen in hotelkamers, vakantiewoningen of stacaravans betaal je vanaf 2026 niet 9% maar 21% btw.

announced_2027.statement: Coalition agreement 2026-2030 plans 16% in 2027, then +1 point a year to 20%
announced_2027.status: proposed (college budget 2027 proposal; council vote reported for 11-12 Nov 2026, not yet held on 2026-11-07)
announced_2027.publisher: Coalition agreement excerpt hosted by KHN; SECONDARY (amsterdam.nl blocked)
announced_2027.quote: We verhogen de toeristenbelasting in een eerste stap naar 16 procent in 2027.

discrepancies.site_says: tip: 'Accommodation VAT in the Netherlands is 21% from 1 January 2026'
discrepancies.official_says: 21% applies to hotel rooms, holiday homes and static caravans; camping pitches remain at 9% (low severity wording issue)

discrepancies.site_says: 'Together they take roughly a third of the quoted rate.'
discrepancies.official_says: 12.5% tax + 21% VAT = 33.5% of the NET rate; as a share of a VAT-inclusive quoted price it is about 28%. Ambiguous, low severity.

amsterdam.notes: Core numbers (12.5% of net room price, 21% VAT from 1 Jan 2026, 16% for 2027 described as a plan) are correct. amsterdam.nl returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; the binding rate was verified from the ordinance text in the official CVDR repository. 'Europe's highest tourist tax', 23.7m overnight stays, bed freeze, rental and cruise caps, Anne Frank/GVB prices were not checked (outside tax scope). No page last-updated date (ordinance dated 2023-11-21).

facts.statement: Catalan tax (IEET), Barcelona-city general rate from 1 April 2026: 5-star/GL 7.00; 4-star 3.40; tourist apartment (HUT) 4.50; youth hostel 1.00; other establishments/campsites 2.00; cruise >12h 4.00, <=12h 6.00 (per person per day)
facts.quote: Hotel de 4 estrelles i 4 estrelles superior ... (EB2) 3,40 € 5,00 € 6,00 € 7,00 €

facts.statement: Totals per person per night from 1 April 2026: 5-star 12, 4-star 8.40, HUT 9.50, other 7, cruise 9 / 11
facts.quote: increasing this surcharge from four to five euros

facts.statement: Maximum 7 stay units per person are taxed
facts.quote: En qualsevol cas, es computa un màxim de set unitats d'estada per persona.

facts.statement: Exempt: persons aged 16 or under; stays subsidised by EU public social programmes
facts.quote: Les persones d'edat igual o inferior a setze anys.

facts.statement: Paid through the establishment and shown separately on the invoice; owner files the return
facts.quote: El pagament es fa a través de l'establiment turístic

facts.statement: Bookings paid in full (stay + tax) before a rate change keep the old rate
facts.quote: la tarifa aplicable és la vigent en el moment de fer la reserva sempre que se satisfaci en aquest moment l'import

announced_2027.statement: Barcelona municipal surcharge rises to 6 EUR for stays 1 Apr 2027-31 Mar 2028 (so 5-star 13, 4-star 9.40, HUT 10.50)
announced_2027.quote: 2027 6€ De l'1 d'abril de 2027 al 31 de març de 2028

announced_2027.quote: Tarifes a partir de l' 01.04.2027 Hotel de 5 estrelles ... (ET1) 6,00 €

discrepancies.site_says: no 'cap' for barcelona, so every night is charged
discrepancies.official_says: Tax is charged on at most 7 stay units per person ('es computa un màxim de set unitats d'estada per persona'). Stays over 7 nights are overstated.

discrepancies.site_says: multiplies the rate by every person, no age note
discrepancies.official_says: Guests aged 16 or under are exempt ('igual o inferior a setze anys').

discrepancies.site_says: no mention of the 7-night cap or the under-17 exemption
discrepancies.official_says: Max 7 nights per person; persons 16 and under exempt.

discrepancies.site_says: title: 'Barcelona tourist tax 2026: 4.50 euros plus 5 euro city surcharge'
discrepancies.official_says: 4.50 is only the tourist-apartment (HUT) rate; hotels are 7.00 (5*) and 3.40 (4*) plus 5. Not false but misleading as a headline rate.

discrepancies.site_says: tiers only 5*, 4*, rental; tip says other categories not listed
discrepancies.official_says: Official also has youth hostel 1.00+5=6.00, other establishments 2.00+5=7.00, cruise 9/11 (omission only).

barcelona.notes: All listed numbers (7/3.40/4.50 base, 5 EUR surcharge, 12/8.40/9.50 totals, up to 11 for cruise, +1 EUR/yr to 8) are correct. The ACM briefing note (acm.cat) on Llei 2/2026 matched ATC. DOGC page for Llei 2/2026 was reached but not parsed (portal shell); facts taken from ATC and the city ordinance. ATC pages show no last-updated date. Ticket prices, licence expiry, illegal-listing and fine figures were not checked (outside tax scope).

lisbon.notes: Rate (4 EUR) and worked examples in the post are correct; calculator (4 EUR, cap 7, 13+) is correct. informacoeseservicos.lisboa.pt returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the city service page (and its last-updated date) could not be read; the Diário da República text was read via the city's open-data portal. Edital 234/2024 in Boletim Municipal 1593 was not opened. No officially announced 2027 change found (searched; none located). Post claim that the tax 'appears as its own line at checkout' not verified.

nice.notes: Every rate in the post and calculator (6.43/4.69/3.48/2.28, 6.70% capped at 6.43, worked examples 41.76/27.36/72.36) matches the official sheet. Rate PDFs show no last-updated date; owner guide PDF is 'actualisé au 4/06/26'.
